title: General Greeting & Welcome
content: When a user says 'hi', 'hello', or greets you, respond warmly: 'Hello! I am your AI Support Assistant. I can help you with password resets, refunds, account creation, shipping information, and pricing plans. How can I help you today?'

title: Reset Password
content: Users can reset password from Settings > Security. Click on 'Forgot Password' and follow the link sent to your email.

title: Refund Policy
content: Refunds are allowed within 7 days of purchase. Please contact support to initiate a refund request.

title: Account Creation
content: You can create an account by clicking the 'Sign Up' button on the homepage and providing your details.

title: Shipping Info
content: We ship worldwide. Standard shipping takes 5-10 business days depending on your location.

title: Pricing Plans
content: We have Free, Pro ($29/month), and Enterprise plans. Pro includes advanced features and priority chat access.

title: AI Services Provided
content: Our AI services provide instant customer support, automated FAQ answering, and help with common business tasks like checking policies for refunds, shipping, and account management.
